description: Prepared and derived non-raster data files used by the pipeline. Each artifact links to its upstream source IDs in data_sources_manifest.json.

artifacts.name: Freguesias to nuts3
artifacts.source_description: Correspondence table mapping Portuguese freguesias to NUTS3 regions.
artifacts.process: Manually prepared from the Eurostat 2016 LAU-to-NUTS correspondence workbook to map Portuguese freguesias to NUTS3 regions.
notes: The source workbook path is recorded under eurostat_lau_nuts in the data-source manifest. .

artifacts.name: Administrative indicators
artifacts.source_description: Combined table of manually harmonized administrative indicators.
artifacts.process: Separate administrative indicator extracts were manually mapped and assembled into a common freguesia-level table. Correspondence tables were used to harmonize indicator categories before combining the columns.
notes: Source-to-indicator mappings are recorded in the data-source manifest. The exact correspondence table files, versions, and column-level transformation steps are not yet fully inventoried.
The repository CSV is a retained snapshot of the manually composed administrative table.

artifacts.name: Parish geometry
artifacts.source_description: Parish boundary geometries prepared from CAOP 2016 shapefiles.
artifacts.process: Built from the CAOP 2016 shapefiles using pipeline/input_preparation/preprocessing/build_parishes.py and the shared geometry helpers.
notes: The source shapefiles are external inputs configured as caop_shapefiles in pipeline/config/external_paths.json.

artifacts.name: Parish processing extent
artifacts.source_description: Processing boundary used to clip and align raster inputs.
artifacts.process: Manually prepared processing extent based on the CAOP parish geometries.
notes: The exact construction steps and any coordinate or buffer choices are not yet recorded.

artifacts.name: Satellite indicators snapshot
artifacts.source_description: Retained parish-level snapshot of satellite indicators generated from raster inputs.
artifacts.process: Retained snapshot of the satellite indicator table produced by the manifest-driven raster-to-freguesia construction pipeline.
notes: The pipeline writes current generated outputs to the configured outputs_root; this CSV is a versioned repository snapshot, not the automatic output destination.
